messages:
Nora (docs): Quick heads-up — I'm about to merge the release summary for the runtime rollout. Need a fast pass on three things before I land: SDK snippet consistency (v1->v2), the migration checklist links, and a short known-quirk blurb about streaming + embeddings. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Devon (eng-runtime): On it. I'll check the code samples against the runtime API surface. Anything specific to watch for?

Nora (docs): Thanks — the main concrete change is the SDK param rename: `model` -> `model_name` in the v2 client. We should show a before/after minimal example. Also we added an optional `stream: true` example that might need the note about partial embeddings when the client interrupts the stream.

Sara (devex): I can rewrite the examples to show both forms side-by-side. Suggestion: short table and a one-liner migration note. Also, can we add a note to the quickstart that `api_key` env var is still accepted but `REDWOOD_API_KEY` is recommended?

Kai (platform): I'll validate the migration guide links. There's a stale internal link in `docs/migrations/README.md` to the old quantization doc — will open a tiny PR to redirect to the updated kernels doc.

Devon (eng-runtime): Re: streaming embeddings — confirmed behavior: if client cancels mid-stream we flush partial vectors, which can be truncated. Recommend wording: "If your client cancels an active embedding stream, the service may return a partial embedding; callers should validate vector length before indexing." I'll paste suggested blurb below.

Nora (docs): Paste it please. Keep it short and prescriptive (one sentence + suggested mitigation).

Devon (eng-runtime): "Known issue: interrupted embedding streams may yield partial vectors. Mitigation: verify vector length and re-request full embedding on mismatch, or use the non-streaming embeddings endpoint for guaranteed atomic responses."

Sara (devex): Snippet tweak proposal:

```js
// v1
const res = await client.generate({model: 'kitefish-v1', prompt: 'Hello'});

// v2 (preferred)
const res = await client.generate({model_name: 'kitefish-v2', prompt: 'Hello'});
```

I'll add a one-line migration callout: "Change `model` -> `model_name`; all other params unchanged."

Ben (release-eng): Also add a tiny timeline line in relnotes: canary starts Thu 09:00 PT, full rollout Fri 04:00 PT, rollback window 2h. Ops will monitor error-rate and p50/p95 latency.

Nora (docs): Perfect. Two last UX asks: 1) make the snippet consistent across the top-level relnotes and the SDK migration page, 2) add a link to the preview build so PMs can scan. Preview: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/runtime-rollout
docs-bot: Preview build deployed — https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/relnotes/runtime-rollout (checks: lint ok, linkcheck: 3 warnings)

Sara (devex): I'll push the snippet PR in a few minutes. I'll also fix the env var line.

Kai (platform): Link redirect PR #483 is ready. It replaces `/quantization-old` with `/kernels-quantization` and updates the TOC.

Devon (eng-runtime): Suggest adding this tiny test note to the relnotes: "If you observe truncated embeddings in search, try re-indexing with the non-streaming embedding endpoint until clients are patched." Keeps ops actionable.

Nora (docs): Good call, add that. OK I'm holding merge until Sara's snippet PR lands and Ben confirms the canary times are in the final notes. If we get both in the next 45m I'll merge and schedule the publish. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Ben (release-eng): Canary times confirmed. I'll be watching the rollout channel.

Sara (devex): PR merged — snippet updated and env var callout fixed. Also fixed one link that 404'd in the quickstart.

Nora (docs): Merging now. Will follow up if the linkcheck bot complains. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :rocket:
